items.title: Japan’s Bond Yields Climb on BOJ Hike Bets, Fiscal Concerns
items.description: Japan’s bonds fell on fiscal concerns and growing speculation that the Bank of Japan may raise interest rates in the coming months, pushing the 10-year yield to the highest since 1996.

items.title: Hong Kong Court Orders Unit of SDIC Commodities to Liquidate
items.description: A unit of China’s state-backed SDIC Commodities Co. was ordered to liquidate by a Hong Kong court, adding to the financial troubles for the metals trader as Beijing increases scrutiny on the sector.

items.description: Shipments of silver into India are picking up despite administrative hurdles, as traders seek to capitalize on attractive premiums after a new licensing regime disrupted imports.

items.description: Copper rose toward a record, with a key price spread in London widening to unusual levels in a sign of intense competition for supply.

items.title: Sri Lankan Inflation to Slow Toward Goal, Central Bank Head Says
items.description: Sri Lanka’s inflation is expected to slow back toward the central bank’s target of 5% over the second half of this year and into next year, according to Governor Nandalal Weerasinghe.

items.description: A nascent rally in the Thai baht may be short-lived as the central bank is likely to maintain a dovish policy stance to support an economy hit by elevated oil prices, according to analysts.
